name: The Cult
description: End-game hidden threat. A creed spreads character to character, across empire borders through ambassadors and diplomats. A colony is cult-held when its governor is converted; once one empire has enough cult-held colonies, the cult declares and rises from inside them into a theocracy.

flags.name: cult
flags.label: The Cult
flags.description: A creed can spread between characters and seize colonies from inside.

params.name: cultForce
params.label: Guarantee against my empire (right-click the add-on in the list)

params.name: cultSecedeMinColonies
params.label: Fewest cult-held colonies needed when an empire has fewer governed colonies than that

params.name: cultAgentDetectPct
params.label: Counter-intelligence detection factor (per mille per espionage point)

params.name: cultStateMoney
params.label: Cult: state money when it rises

params.name: cultPrivateMoney
params.label: Cult: private money when it rises

params.name: cultIncomeFloor
params.label: Cult: income floor per month (topped up to this while it lives)

params.name: cultSmallPorts
params.label: Cult: small space ports besides the medium one (no upkeep)

params.name: cultNavyPct
params.label: Cult: starting fleet as % of the host empire's military

params.name: cultConstructionShips
params.label: Cult: construction ships kept working (so its AI can build mining stations)

params.name: cultStationCount
params.label: Cult: nearest mining stations taken from the host when none is in the colony system

params.name: cultExistChancePct
params.label: Chance the Cult exists in this game (%; -1 = use the shared value)

params.name: cultMinYear
params.label: Earliest year the Cult may seed or trigger (-1 = use the shared value)
